# Vessel.js

`vessel.mjs` is the unmodified `build/vessel.module.js` from the npm package
`@shiplab/vessels@0.0.14` (module revision v0.14-alpha).
Source: https://github.com/shiplab/vesseljs
License: MIT; see LICENSE.vessel.md.

The standalone build is vendored because this release lists its build/test
stack as runtime dependencies and has an incorrect package main entry.
The declaration file describes only the API consumed by this application.
